scope: Local kind with its pinned Kubernetes 1.36.1 node image and containerd CRI; compares /proc/self/uid_map for a default Pod and a Pod explicitly setting hostUsers: false. Establishes kernel UID mapping and basic BusyBox operation only when the host kernel and runtime support Pod user namespaces. Does not establish escape resistance, host filesystem isolation, or production support.
